title: SaBaKi – The Very Special Event
description:
🇬🇧🇬🇧 3, 2, 1… We’re starting the 12th edition of an event that will be remembered for a long time!
Starting in 2025, after a four-year of break, we’ve changed our profile to 100% Angola! Urban Kiz has no place here. Two days of workshops, two Kizombadas, two socials—sound like a plan? Join us, we assure you, it’s worth it!
